title: Verify the battle descriptor alias with generated dispatch
changes: Compare the recorded battle-entry route using the shared descriptor-1 row while generated dispatch is enabled and managed ROM source bytes are altered.
validation: Windows GNU build alias-battle-translated-build-l2ak3_g2 and Wine alias-battle-translated-wine-3s1xbvpx passed. E170-d169 raw/managed paths match full state, clock, central/wide video, OAM and five nonempty audio streams on each of 240 frames with 14 row bytes altered. Five typed row requests occurred, with no raw, unclassified or dropped requests; guarded inputs passed, scratch was removed and Wine drained.
Restored the preexisting test-file formatting after execution; rustfmt-normalized source was verified identical to the tested build.
limitations: Generated blocks can fall back to interpretation; aggregate row reads do not establish per-read native attribution or complete importer behavior. Other scenes, consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
